lines.en: Stubborn little street rabble. As you wish, we will hold back no longer.  Commander Trihan, converge on Protagonist's position with all available forces! Crush them!
lines.zh: 顽固的街头混混。就如你所愿，我们将全力进攻。 特里罕指挥官，调动所有可用部队，向Protagonist进攻！碾碎他们！
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: My Duke, we have word that there is a massive riot in the streets of Rimorgue!  The mob is calling for an end to war and they demand compensation!  Our government has been exiled!
lines.zh: 公爵，我们收到消息，里莫格街头发生了大规模骚乱！ 暴民们呼吁结束战争，而且他们还要求补偿！ 我们的政府被流放了！

lines.en: What?!  Why now?!  Then we mustn't waste time!  We must take Fort Eureeka without delay - overwhelm their defenses! Charge!!
lines.zh: 什么？！ 为什么会是现在？！ 那我们就不能浪费时间了！ 我们必须立刻拿下尤里卡堡——摧毁他们的防御工事！冲啊！！

lines.en: So, it's come to this...  Lysander, how could I have miscalculated this bad...
lines.zh: 所以，事情到了这一步…… 莱森德，我怎么会做出如此糟糕的误判……

lines.en: Don't worry about it. Look at them, they're fools.  Preparing to charge a position as heavily fortified as this.  They're throwing lives away... one has to wonder why.  As long as we control the chokepoints in the walls, Fort Eureeka will hold.
lines.zh: 别担心。看看他们，一群蠢货而已。 竟然准备向如此坚堡发起冲锋。 他们正在浪费生命……我很好奇原因。 只要我们控制着城墙的关键要道，尤里卡堡就守得住。
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Hopefully they'll take enough damage to lose their appetite for bloodshed...
lines.zh: 但愿他们会遭受足够多的伤亡，从而失去对流血冲突的胃口……

lines.en: \c[1]Permadeath has been turned off for this chapter.
lines.zh: \c[1]永久死亡已在本章关闭。

lines.en: Terenor! Stop this!  You can call it all off and realize you've been mislead.  Casamir thinks he can wag you around like a dog...  we musn't give him what he wants!
lines.zh: 特瑞诺！停止这一切！ 你还有机会停战，然后意识到自己是被误导了。 卡萨米尔觉得他可以像逗狗一样遛着你…… 我们不能让他得逞！

lines.en: It is too late for that now, Protagonist.  One of us will die today, so unless you wish to leave this world in disgrace, raise your weapon!
lines.zh: Protagonist，已经太迟了。 今天我们俩只能活一个，所以除非你想屈辱地离开这个世界，否则就举起你的武器来吧！

lines.en: Ugh... you ARE a predictable oaf!  Fine, then die the lapdog of a traitor!
lines.zh: 呃……你真是个无可救药的蠢蛋！ 很好，那就作为叛徒的走狗去死吧！

lines.en: Ugh...  Donar, forgive me...
lines.zh: 呃啊…… 多纳尔，请宽恕我……

lines.en: With Terenor dead... what's going to happen??
lines.zh: 特瑞诺死了……接下来呢？？

lines.en: A meaningless death.  But Casamir's still out there.  We need to stay vigilant!
lines.zh: 这家伙死的毫无意义。 但卡萨米尔还在虎视眈眈。 我们得保持警惕！
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Oh, Terenor died in battle?  How unfortunate.  It seems we will have to clean up this mess now.
lines.zh: 哦，特瑞诺战死了？ 真不幸啊。 看来现在得由我们来收拾这个烂摊子了。
lines.name: 卡西米尔

lines.en: What the...?!
Such firepower...  they lured us to a trap.  As if they knew we'd be here exactly at this time. How...
lines.zh: 如此凶猛的火力…… 他们把我们引诱到了陷阱里。 仿佛他们提前知道我们此刻会在这里一样。怎么会……
lines.name: 莱桑德

lines.en: Everyone, fall back to the keep!  Stay out of range of those cannons! Maybe we can hold them off if we stand strong!
lines.zh: 全军，退回要塞！ 不要进入大炮的射程！坚持住，我们或许可以挡住他们！

lines.en: Jules...  we have followed Protagonist into the jaws of Hell...
lines.zh: 朱尔斯…… 我们跟着Protagonist到了地狱的门口……
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: It is a tough situation indeed, Narima.  We're still alive, though.
lines.zh: 情况确实很恶劣，娜瑞玛。 不过，我们都还活着。

lines.en: Jules, if it comes down to it, would you die for Protagonist?  Would you die in this war among squabbling Veridian nobles?
lines.zh: 朱尔斯，如果万一，你愿意为Protagonist而死吗? 你愿意死在这场维尔迪亚贵族间的闹剧战争里吗？
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Narima...  we're all here together.  I don't want anyone to die, and that includes you and I!  Why are you so worried about me over the others?
lines.zh: 娜瑞玛…… 我们都在一条船上。 我不希望任何人死掉，包括你和我！ 你为什么这么担心我而不是其他人？

lines.en: ...  Someday you'll know.  But not today.  Today your job is to survive, do you understand?!
lines.zh: …… 总有一天你会明白的。 但不是现在。 你现在的任务就是活下去，明白吗？！
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Same to you, Narima.  You've looked out for me so much thus far, so I'm not going to let you throw yourself away either!  Come on, let us defend this fortress as a true Sayunaari would!
lines.zh: 你也一样，娜瑞玛。 你一直那么照顾我，我也不会让你牺牲你自己的！ 来吧，让我们像真正的萨育纳人一样守卫这座堡垒！

lines.en: Truly noble in deed... Donar watch over you.
lines.zh: 如此高贵的作风……愿多纳尔守护你。
lines.name: 娜瑞玛

lines.en: Sybil, you stay sharp out there, y'here me?  I got a funny feelin' about me now.  Not a good one.
lines.zh: 茜比尔，保持敏锐，听到没？ 我现在感觉有些古怪。 不是好的那种。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: You goin' soft on us or what?!  This is what I live for!  My heart is racing...  if only I could feel like this all the time.  It's like there's fire flowing through me!
lines.zh: 你是丧失斗志还是怎么啦？！ 我活着就是为了在战场上拼杀！ 我的心在狂跳…… 要是任何时候都能体会到这种感觉该多好。 好似有股火焰在我身上流淌一样！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Listen t'me, kiddo...  this ain't lookin' pretty.  I been down this road before.  You'd should trust this old man's gut feelin' - it's the best friend I got.
lines.zh: 听我说，孩子…… 局势看上去不好。 我有过类似的经历。 你应该相信这位老人的直觉——它是我最好的朋友。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: ... Whaddya mean?  You don't think we'll make it?!
lines.zh: …… 你在说什么？ 你觉得我们赢不了吗？！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Ain't nothin' like that, just...
lines.zh: 我不是这意思，只是……
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: Barnabas...  How'd such a sweet man end up a soldier anyway?  Come on, we can do this!  They'll have to kill me a thousand times before they win!
lines.zh: 巴纳巴斯…… 这么可爱的男人怎么就跑来当兵了呢？ 拜托，我们能行！ 他们要是不把我打倒千百次可绝对赢不了！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: Stefan, you seem shaken.
lines.zh: 斯泰凡，你看起来有些动摇。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: I'm doin' okay!  No really... I'm fine!
lines.zh: 我没事！ 不，真的……我好着呢！
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: It seems the enemy has lured us into an impossible situation.  This may be the end.
lines.zh: 看来敌人把我们引诱到了绝境。 也许这就是结局了。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: ...  Y'always were a bright and sunny personality, Diana.
lines.zh: …… 你真是一如既往的阳光，戴安娜。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: As you would say, "don't shoot the messenger."
lines.zh: 就像你会说的：“别怪罪带来坏消息的人啊。”
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Yeah, I'd probably say that...
lines.zh: 是啊，我可能确实会说……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Yer serious, aren't ya...
lines.zh: 你是认真的， 是不是……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Stefan... this is not the life for you.  I will not tell the others should you happen to slip away.  If I fall in battle, I need you to protect my Alex.
lines.zh: 斯泰凡……这不该是你的归宿。 如果你悄悄溜走，我不会告诉其他人的。 如果我战死了，我需要你保护我的艾利克斯。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Diana...
lines.zh: 戴安娜……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Just promise me that...
lines.zh: 答应我就好……
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: ...Alright, alright!  ...Bah, you've always gotta talk about dyin'.  You may not care if that happens but damn, some of us sure will.
lines.zh: ……好吧，好吧！ ……呸，你总是动不动就讲生讲死的。 你可能觉得无所谓，死了就死了。可有人会觉得有所谓的，干。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: If they do kill me, my body will perish, but they will never see a Paladin on their knees.  Until such time, do keep count of how many fall to my hammer... and tell the world what it means to go against the Paladins of holy Donar.
lines.zh: 如果他们真的杀了我，虽然我的肉体会湮灭，但要让圣骑士屈服下跪就是痴心妄想。 真到那时，请帮我记着，有多少人倒在了我的战锤之下……并告诉全世界，胆敢与神圣的多纳尔的圣骑士作对的代价。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Now you're talkin'!  Come on, let's make a story that'll be burned into memory for a thousand years!
lines.zh: 这才像话嘛！ 来吧，让我们创造一段值得传颂千年的传奇吧！
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en:
Zelos...  I couldn't make it.  Wherever you are, you'll have to make things right...
All this carnage, because I thought I knew what the hell I was doing...
Casamir...  Someone... something...  will destroy you.  Even if I must from the grave...
lines.zh: 卡萨米尔…… 总会有人，总会有什么…… 会推翻你。 哪怕需要我从坟墓里……
